title: TestFlight review contact information
summary: The contact details Beta App Review will ask for to distribute to the external "testers" group.
why: Every build distributed to external TestFlight testers goes through Apple's beta review, and Apple asks for a contact person. The details are written to `fastlane/beta_review_info.json` and sent automatically with every release.

steps.title: Choose a person Apple can contact with questions
steps.detail: They must be reachable during the review; a support email is preferred.

steps.title: If the app requires sign-in, write a note
steps.detail: Since sign-in is with Google/Apple, a demo account is usually not needed; briefly explain how the reviewer can try the main flow.

fields.label: Phone (with country code)
fields.patternHint: Must start with + and the country code.

fields.label: Reviewer note
fields.placeholder: Sign in with Google or Apple. Main flow: …
